spec.description:
Autex Surface Finishes Ceiling Tiles (including Acoustic Timber Ceiling Tiles)
are high-performance acoustic ceiling tiles designed to drop into standard
suspended ceiling grids with authentic natural material finishes. Utilizing
high-definition digital UV printing with safe water-based inks, realistic timber
grains and stone textures are applied directly to 12mm non-woven polyester
acoustic tiles. Delivering an NRC of 0.85 without the weight, rigidity, or cost
of real wood or stone, they provide Class A acoustic absorption and Group 1 fire
compliance.
features:
Digitally printed natural material finishes
including 24 timber grains and stone textures

Engineered to fit standard
metric 600mm x 600mm and 1200mm x 600mm suspended ceiling grids

High acoustic
performance achieving NRC 0.85 (Class A sound absorption)

Lightweight,
semi-rigid polyester construction that will not chip, crack, or break

Printed
with safe, water-based, UV-cured ink that does not compromise acoustics

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum of 78% to 80%
recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and
AS 5637.1

Resistant to moisture, mould, and mildew (ASTM G21-15 Growth
Rating: 0)
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install:
Inspect suspended ceiling grid ensuring it is level,
square, and structurally sound

Verify all boxes are from the same production
batch to maintain print texture and grain consistency

Angle tile upward
through the metric ceiling grid opening (600x600 or 1200x600)

Align timber
grain or stone pattern direction consistently across adjacent modules

Lower
tile into position squarely so edges rest evenly on T-bar grid flanges

Trim
perimeter tiles carefully from the face using a straight edge and sharp utility
knife
selection_checklist:
Select finish from Acoustic Timber
woodgrains (24 options) or Surface Finishes stone collection

Verify consistent grain alignment across
ceiling layout

Check that all boxes match batch numbers to prevent
variation
Ensure compliance with NCC Group 1 fire rating for ceilings
accessories: Standard two-way exposed ceiling grid (15mm or 24mm tee)
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid
wet areas or direct water leaks

Designed for non-contact ceiling grid
installation; avoid repeated surface abrasion

Do not mix batches in the same
contiguous ceiling area

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Surface Finishes Ceiling Tiles (including Acoustic Timber
Ceiling Tiles) are 12mm thick acoustic drop-in tiles for standard 600mm x 600mm
and 1200mm x 600mm suspended ceiling grids. Printed with high-resolution natural
timber grains or stone textures using water-based UV-cured ink on 100% polyester
felt, they replicate real wood panelling without the weight or fire hazards.
Delivering Class A sound absorption (NRC 0.85) and Group 1 fire compliance under
AS ISO 9705, they provide a lightweight, carbon-neutral ceiling transformation
for high-end corporate and hospitality interiors.
